mission: Use three UAVs to occupy all landmarks and avoid redundant coverage.
Deploy six aircraft across the marked sites so that no site is left unattended; keep them separated.
UAV1-6 pursue UAV7-8. The pursuers cooperate to capture the evaders, who try to escape.
Four aircraft close on two fleeing opponents; the opposing pair tries to stay away from the interceptors.
A stationary speaker knows the goal and must guide a moving listener to that landmark.
Only the immobile guide is told the destination. It must communicate that information so two mobile followers can arrive there.
A sender and receiver share a key. Transmit and recover the private symbol while an eavesdropper tries to infer it without the key.
Protect a confidential two-bit value in transit. Its intended recipient can use shared secret information; a third participant overhears the transmission and attempts reconstruction.
Arrange five formation members in assigned positions around a circular landmark.
Place eight aircraft at their designated evenly spaced sites on a ring and maintain separation.
Five formation members must occupy evenly spaced slots on the line between two endpoints.
Organize six aircraft into a straight row between the two markers, each moving to its own assigned site.
A mobile leader and pursuers chase foragers. The leader shares sightings; foragers visit food and use cover or evasive motion to avoid capture.
The better-informed mobile participant directs teammates toward fleeing resource seekers. Seekers need food and must protect themselves by hiding in forest or moving away from threats.
Collectors pick up treasures and deliver them to mobile red or blue deposits that move to meet carriers of matching cargo.
Gather parcels one at a time and carry each to the recipient of the same color. Both receiving units should approach compatible loaded carriers.
Informed agents approach a secret goal while an adversary tries to identify and reach it. Decoy landmarks are available.
Some participants know the confidential destination and need to get there without revealing it; an uninformed opponent observes them and tries to locate the same destination.
